source.description: Install the verified Nuclei RISC-V Embedded Toolchain for Windows from Nuclei's official download server, tested with Nuclei GCC 2020.08 / GCC 9.2.0, then set NUCLEI_GCC_BIN, RISCV_NUCLEI_GCC_BIN, RISCV_TOOLCHAIN_BIN, or PATH to the directory containing riscv-nuclei-elf-gcc.exe. Newer GCC 14.x toolchains are not compatible with the current binary SDK library.
